description: Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Declared as road and lanes owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Ibbagamuwa (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of road coordinates, dimensions, and ownership claims processes, which falls under land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land development matters - all characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
